sampling_date_resolution: December2017; exact day not reported in inspected methods
hatchery_design: Bred and wild populations separately reared in two tanks; same stated procedures. Tank and breeding group are not independently replicated.
individual_genotypes: Not available in the inspected manifest or methods; do not invent per-pool genotypes
adjustment_limits: Collection month/site are shared, so they cannot be estimated as varying covariates. Breeding line/genetic background and hatchery tank history cannot be separated with this design. Existing model is condition-only, not genotype-adjusted.

dekupl_query_export.selection: All merged full-depth contigs with BH-adjusted pvalue strictly<0.05; original sample/effect fields retained; no cap
dekupl_query_export.state: Submitted; current completion unverified after SSH authentication failure

required_searches: Search DE-kupl separately from SPLASH against public bivalve runs at10/100 and Swiss-Prot protein/Dayhoff/HP at5, using validated stop-free query/reference settings. Preserve original IDs, adjusted scores, counts and shared sequence membership. No inferred splicing from nonsignificant gene expression.
